key_insight: AI agents improved quantum compilation designs while a frozen, exact verifier certified every result, reducing targeted costs by up to 73% at the largest sizes tested.
engineering_relevance: Automated, verifiable optimization could lower quantum circuit resource requirements and help algorithms scale to real devices.
method: An agent formulates the optimization challenge with a researcher and builds an exact verifier.
The verifier is validated against a solved case, deliberately broken solutions and published results, then frozen.
Agents iteratively improve programs against a fixed evaluator, recording notes that later agents can build on.
evidence_signal: Across fermion-to-qubit encoding, Hamiltonian layout and unitary synthesis, agents improved on published or standard constructions and outperformed a state-of-the-art encoding optimizer.
watch_item: The method requires exact, efficient verification; certification establishes correctness, not global optimality or real-device performance.
paper_title: Automating quantum circuit optimization with AI agents
